statement: Make DevRelay easy to adopt and operate as a deterministic open-source engineering runtime without weakening its verified lifecycle, evidence, authority, or provider-neutrality.
objectives: Expose a small facade and risk-scaled workflow profiles for ordinary ChatGPT Desktop use.
Separate advanced APIs, compatibility surfaces, and optional domain packs from the root API.
Reduce repository evidence weight while preserving independently verifiable full evidence through GitHub Release assets.
Deliver a durable Windows local host and deterministic CLI beneath ChatGPT Desktop.
Ship the work as bounded reviewable changes and identify it honestly as 0.10.0-rc.2 until independent stable review exists.
constraints: Do not weaken Core-owned routing, validation, Gates, checkpoints, traceability, or progression.
Preserve the exact V0.11 implementation and evidence-seal commits and do not rewrite published history.
ChatGPT Desktop on Windows is the release-defining product host.
Godot and GdUnit4 remain optional domain-pack capabilities.
Every workflow profile retains adaptive requirements closure at or above 0.99.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean Windows Desktop user can run, resume, verify, and inspect through a small facade and CLI without constructing internal artifacts.
Profiles scale depth and cost without bypassing Core or applicable Gates.
Advanced, compatibility, and domain-pack APIs have explicit tested boundaries.
Full evidence remains checksum-verifiable after externalization from Git.
The local host recovers deterministic state across defined crash windows.
The release remains preview-labeled until exact independent human review is recorded.
assumptions: The owner's 'Yes for all' approves the twelve normalized decisions in clarification wave 1 exactly as stated.
GitHub source and GitHub Release assets are the approved distribution surfaces.
The current V0.11 evidence-sealed branch is the immutable implementation baseline.
